rootCause.summary: Workflow job env PANTHEON_HOSTED_FE_HARD_GATE=false (pre-switch hosted evidence advisory, LOOP-PROD-FE-001) turned every hosted fail/missing into a bare 'warn'. route_load, mgmt_load_gate and the hosted desktop e2e step outcomes were never read by the aggregate, and Gate 5 F12 read only the loopback fixture lane (@approval-local), so real hosted failures were invisible and the job concluded success.
rootCause.sourceRun: gate 43108247755 / job 130817129871 (raw history preserved, not rewritten)

changes: aggregate: hostedStatus downgrade is now 'advisory_fail' (never pass, never bare warn); non-blocking exit semantics unchanged
aggregate: Gate 8 now reads real step outcomes for route_load, mgmt_load_gate, mgmt_hosted_accept, e2e (skipped = fail)
aggregate: Gate 8 hosted F12 owner readback read from playwright-desktop-results.json only; fixture results never satisfy it

REVIEW FIX: required authenticated probe checks (route_load, mgmt_load_gate, mgmt_hosted_accept, e2e, hosted F12) are strict fail/missing regardless of HOSTED_FE_HARD_GATE; Gate 7 fails and aggregate exits 1, so candidate_upload (needs aggregate success) cannot publish. Only stale-host readback checks remain advisory_fail.

REVIEW FIX 3: e2e/12-approvals.spec.ts assertOwnerReadback accepts an authenticated 200 with an empty owner list (no seeding); 401/non-200, malformed envelope, missing auth and invalid present rows still fail.

REVIEW FIX 2 (superseded): the earlier in-job dev-login mint was removed; it put secrets.* into the ordinary secretless integration-gate job, violating the maintained boundary asserted by paired-release-workflow.test.ts. No credential path is added to that job.

REVIEW FIX 4: probe-route-load-baseline.mjs and accept-management-hosted-production.mjs no longer write the bearer into retired browser storage keys/localStorage; an inlined pinned-bearer helper in each script attaches Authorization per-request only to the pinned maintained dev BFF origin, and refuses (before use) unless the FE target is the maintained dev FE or a loopback exact-candidate preview.
unchanged: no new auth issuer/token/secret; hosted auth probes still need the existing genuine short-lived token and fail honestly without it
write proof and finite Loops/provider cases remain not-applicable/skipped; gate-before-switch, manifest admission and rollback untouched
stale-host readback checks (gate 3/4, Gate 8 core evidence) remain advisory pre-switch; required authenticated probes no longer are
sourceTests: vitest auth-truth now covers genuine success, missing-auth (skipped/failure/cancelled) exit 1, and permitted write/Loops/provider skips; see run output in task closeout
notProven: No real protected-run or hosted proof from this source-only worker; local operator/original publisher own the authenticated gate execution.
authApplicability: Exact evidence: workflow integration-gate (pantheon-integration-gate.yml ~L433-440, L482-484) is credential-free and excluded for proof opt-ins; no BFF_AUTH_TOKEN / PANTHEON_BFF_SMOKE_BEARER_TOKEN is provisioned in it. The only existing /bff/auth/dev-login bootstrap (~L1781-1821) lives in authorized-write-proof and exports Persona/PINT tokens only, under one-time parent-bound child proof claim. Consequence: with the corrected gate, integration-gate authenticated probes (route_load, mgmt_hosted_accept, hosted F12) fail honestly as missing-auth and block candidate publication until native wiring exists. No secret, dispatch input, issuer/grant, credential copy or write enablement was added, and hard checks are not weakened.
